title: The Promotion That Worked — And Still Failed
hook: Seventy visitors landed on his site yesterday, and not a single one got an answer.
voiceover_text: Seventy visitors landed on his site yesterday, and not a single one got an answer. He ran a promotion. A real one. Paid for it. Watched the session count climb all afternoon — sitting there thinking, this is actually working. Seventy people. In one afternoon. For a local plumbing business, that's a flood. But here's what he didn't see. Every single visitor landed on the same static page. Scrolled. Had a question. Typed it somewhere. Got nothing back. And quietly opened the next tab. Then the next one did the same. Then the next. He saw seventy sessions. He didn't see seventy exits. Next morning: zero calls. Zero form fills. Zero new customers. He looked at the analytics and decided the promotion was a waste of money. He was wrong. The promotion worked perfectly. It sent seventy real people to his website. The website just couldn't say a single word back. That's not a traffic problem. That's a website that has no voice. Your next promotion is going to send people somewhere. Make sure somewhere can actually answer them.
